title: Populate features/profiles/profiles.dart barrel exports so Rule 2 is satisfiable for the whole feature
why: Every other actually-used feature barrel re-exports its public API (account.dart 21 exports, tracks.dart 26, tutoring.dart 22, progress.dart 1); profiles.dart has zero `export` statements, so its own header comment ('Import this barrel... Do NOT import deep paths directly') is impossible to follow. Grepping lib/features/**/*.dart for `features/profiles/` outside the profiles feature itself finds 65 files across 10+ other features deep-importing active_profile_provider.dart, profile_providers.dart, profile_model.dart, pin_service.dart etc. directly (plus lib/app/router/app_shell.dart, which can't even use the barrel since it exports nothing). Rule 2 is therefore 100% unenforceable for the single most cross-cut feature in the app: any future rename/move inside features/profiles/ breaks an unpredictable subset of 65+ files with no compiler-visible contract boundary.
recommendation: Populate profiles.dart with export statements for the feature's actual public surface (profile_model.dart, profile_repository.dart, pin_service.dart, active_profile_provider.dart, profile_providers.dart, profile_switcher_sheet.dart, etc.), mirroring the structure already used in tutoring.dart, then migrate consumers off deep imports incrementally.
acceptance_criteria: features/profiles/profiles.dart exports every symbol currently deep-imported by 2+ other features

learning_tracker/Makefile check 15/15 (once its self-comparison bug is fixed, see the tutored_children_section.dart finding) shows a declining, tracked count of profiles/ deep imports outside the feature
New cross-feature consumers of profiles/ import only features/profiles/profiles.dart
